reviews.title: Money Hungry
reviews.text:
Had this app for two years now and at first it was good, playable, not many ads and not many things behind a paywall. Now the creators are just money hungry. Unless you get the pass, it is basically unplayable. Before the updates, we were able to get up to level 43 however now the levels are stuck behind a paywall. One day the tasks were there, the next they were gone. 
All the games used to be free yet now some are behind a paywall. Also if you want to try and earn coins in the game, after around 2 levels you will get a long ad which usually lasts for at least 30 seconds. The ad breaks used to be every 10 levels but they need their money so they reduced it.
Also the amount of bugs now, freezing at so many parts and some clothing simply not working. 
It’s simply not playable anymore and I don’t recommend downloading.

reviews.title: Promising concept, ruined by bugs and greed
reviews.text:
As a game designer, I can appreciate the creativity behind Friends – Raise AI Companions. The idea of co-parenting a virtual pet with friends is fresh and engaging, and the customization options are charming. However, the execution is so poor that it overshadows any potential the game might have.

The game is riddled with bugs: constant crashes, freezing during mini-games, and an interface that feels like it was barely tested. I’ve had to force-close the app more times than I can count, and the loading screens are painfully slow. For a game that’s supposed to be relaxing, it’s anything but.

The monetization strategy is aggressive to the point of being predatory. Ads pop up after every minor action, and the “Pengu Pass” timer is a blatant attempt to pressure players into spending money. Even basic interactions are interrupted by full-screen ads, making the experience feel more like a chore than entertainment.

It’s a shame because the core concept—raising a virtual pet with someone else—is genuinely innovative. But when the game is this unstable and the player experience is this disrespectful, it’s hard to recommend. The developers need to focus on fixing the fundamentals before pushing more monetization schemes.
Uninstalling.
I wanted to love this game, but the constant crashes and ad spam make it unplayable. Clean up the code, respect your players, and maybe then it’ll be worth a second look.

reviews.title: Amazing concept, with a few hiccups
reviews.text:
I adore this game and enjoy playing it with my boyfriend because we love penguins. However, I find it irritating that there are SO MANY ads (though I understand why). It would be amazing to have a little less ads. One additional thing I’d love to see is if you choose to put a bow, it doesn’t automatically remove the hair.
I would also like the Widget to be accurate. It tells us that our penguin is dying all the time, but it’s rarely the case that it is close to dying, it’s always fed and loved.
Also: we look forward to more rooms (after a café).

reviews.title: Used to be good, not now though
reviews.text:
Me an my partner have been raising ours for so long now, I even bought the no ad bundle (which like it said, removed ads) I even got pengu pass for a few months to try it out and decided it wasn’t worth it so just went back to playing normally (with my no ads bundle I payed for) 

Low and behold, I start getting ads on thing I didn’t before, extra flasks for mini game, sending extra hearts, and even the daily spin, first of all why does the first daily spin even need an ad to use? 

I now cant even love and pet Batista without getting an advert for pengu pass, the support system is none existent just sending you to an ai chatbot which says ‘our team will get back to you within 24 hours’ (spoilers, its been a week) 

Debating re-buying the pengu pass to see if the passes ‘no ads’ actually eliminate the ads the no ad bundle should have eliminated, but I dont want to spent any more money on a game that clearly has no respect for its customers and consumers.

I would personally avoid this game until either they stop being so cash grabby or they eventually sell onto a developer team that actually cares.

Would rate 0 if I could
Lovingly, Josh (Batistas parent)
